title: Feed Mode
description: A single-presentation demo capsule that shows only the mobile Feed surface.

sections.title: Feed mode
sections.body: A scrollable column of cards. Skim top to bottom, the way you'd read a timeline.

sections.title: Glanceable
sections.body: Each card is a self-contained beat. Good for updates, release notes, and digests you scan quickly.

sections.title: Derived, not separate
sections.body: The feed is generated from the same sections as every other view. One source, many presentations.

sections.title: Calm by default
sections.body: No autoplay, no network, no tracking. Just cards you scroll at your own pace.

sections.title: That's feed
sections.body: Everything here is sealed inside a single portable HTML capsule.
